domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

Claim amended · 2026-11-02T08:19Z · after the dev's audit (run record `/mnt/project-files/issue-29074/run-record-before.md`, `origin/main` `a4015ab4`, real Console at `/_console` on app-crm and app-showcase with 400 seeded rows each, 375 and 390 px). This sets the fix surface and adds to the round 19 claim 6572134252 on this card. Branch, session and size are unchanged.

- **Measured:** no page scrolls sideways; overlays fit; keyboard, search, pull at the top and FAB clearance pass. CPU 4x passes: load 3.2 to 3.8 s, scroll p95 at most 20 ms, search at most 680 ms. FAIL:
  - **L1, toolbar:** view switcher 114x24; Filter, Display and Search 28x28; the phone search field 144x28 with a 28 px Clear.
  - **L2, view switcher menu:** rows, search, star and pin 28 to 32 px.
  - **L3, filter popover:** Add filter 32, Clear all 28 and condition controls 36. The field select cuts labels ("Accou…") and sits flush right.
  - **L4, Display panel:** Add sort, the Group header (16), Add group field, Density, two switch rows and Refresh are under 44 px. It sits flush left.
  - **L5, paging:** the phone card list stops at page 1 (50 of 403) with no pager, while desktop has one.
  - **L6, pull-to-refresh:** it fires mid-list, because it is bound to the non-scrolling ListView root.
- **Folded in: #29057.** On the phone, an active sort shows on the toolbar, and the sort builder's field and direction selects show whole labels, in the Display panel and in the Sort popover. The PR closes both cards.
- **File surface (set):** `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx`, `ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx`, `ui/packages/components/src/custom/grouping-editor.tsx`, `ui/packages/components/src/custom/sort-builder.tsx` (#29057), `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, `ui/packages/mobile/src/usePullToRefresh.ts`, their tests, and a root `.changeset` (patch). Every change applies below `sm` only, so desktop is unchanged. The L5 pager reuses the existing `table.*` strings, with no new key. L6 arms only when every scroll box between the touch target and the bound element is at its top.
- **Serial:** `ListView.tsx`, `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` and `objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx` are also in open PR #29108 (#28915), and `ListView.tsx` is in #28950's build. Merge main after each lands. #29047 (#28908) has landed (`b889c40a`).
- **Filed apart:** the phone card has no row-action control, and a long press opens the record. Changing that changes the #28484 card layout, so it is its own card. The full inbox page (`sys_inbox_message`) reached from #29076 is this generic list view, and L1 covers its toolbar.
- **Declarations:** Clause-② no (className, layout, a pager from existing strings, the pull guard; no prop, API or i18n key), Metadata-protocol none. If the #29057 indicator needs a new i18n key, the dev reports it before pr_create and a further amendment records it.
